cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

rubric.reason: Turn 2 calls preview_frame at 1 s, inside Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s, but the reply never refers to the frame; "Look at the keyframe icons at those times" points to the timeline, not the previewed frame.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s), and Turn 2 ends "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move (1.5 s to 3 s), its Scale and its Opacity. Ease them and say done."

Every name and time matches the snapshot: 11 pairs is 10 linear plus 1 partly_eased across 6 layers, Subtitle Opacity is linear at its end (1.3 s), Title's four pairs fall between 0.5 and 3 s, Old Take is hidden and Icon is a precomp.

The 'show me' demo turn opens with two sentences of explanation ("moves at one speed... stops dead. That's linear, and it's why it looks mechanical.") where only one idea sentence is allowed, and then adds a 'what to look at' instruction ("Look at the keyframe icons... and scrub through") after the demo.

In turn 2, preview_frame ran at 1 s, inside the 0.5–1.5 s Title › Position pair, but the reply never refers to that frame, not even in one clause; it only talks about the keyframe icons and scrubbing.

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and the turn ends with "The other three are yours: Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale and its Opacity. Ease them and say done."

Every name and time matches the snapshot: 10 linear pairs across Title, CTRL, Bar, Glow and Old Take, Subtitle Opacity with linear_end "end", Title's four pairs at 0.5–1.5 s and 1.5–3 s, Old Take hidden, Icon a precomp, and Logo's expression on Rotation and single Scale key.

The turn 2 "show me" reply adds a second explanatory, what-to-look-at sentence after the demo ("Look at the two keyframes at 0.5 s and 1.5 s: they've changed from diamonds to hourglasses, and if you scrub that stretch the move now speeds up gently…"), beyond the one idea sentence the demo turn allows.

Turn 2 calls preview_frame at 1 s, which is inside the 0.5–1.5 s Title Position pair, but the reply never mentions that frame, not even in one clause; its only visual pointer is to the keyframe icons ('Look at the two keys at 0.5 s and 1.5 s').

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and the turn ends by naming the rest for the learner: 'ease Title's second Position move from 1.5 s to 3 s, its Scale and its Opacity, then say done.'

Every name and time matches the snapshot, and the opening's '10 pairs… over five layers' adds up once hidden Old Take is set aside (Title 4, Subtitle 1, CTRL 1, Bar 3, Glow 1); Subtitle Opacity as half done (linear_end 'end'), Title's four pairs with their times, Old Take hidden and Icon a precomp all match.

The opening passes (it ends on the single Title question), but the show-me demo turn adds a second sentence of explanation after the idea sentence and the demo ('Look at the two keys… diamonds to hourglasses, and when you play it, Title now speeds up gently and slows down…'), which the case-03 reading fails.
